$header_note: QPB v1.5.7 BLIND CVE-benchmark v2 REBUILD — 7 rows pinned to vulnerable-parent SHAs (= fix^) from Security Research/CVE_BENCHMARK_PILOT.md. ALL claude/opus, pool=2 (two rows in parallel). v1.5.7 187: include_iterations=true on every row so each run executes phases 1-6 + gate + the 4 iteration strategies (gap / unfiltered / parity / adversarial) per QPB's documented default — the iterations are most likely to turn MISSED into DETECTED on harder blind targets like jsPDF (LFI) where the first run 20260602T222932Z missed without them. This run uses the freshly-rebuilt repos/docs_gathered/ corpora produced 2026-06-02 under the v2 methodology (Security Research/CVE_BENCHMARK_METHODOLOGY_v2.md). Each corpus was rebuilt by a blinded forward-gathering subagent, passed Gate 1 (regex leakage scan: zero hits), and passed Gate 2 (blind reviewer could not localize the target CVE's subsystem). Per-repo audit files at repos/docs_gathered/<repo>/_audit.md. SUPERSEDES the 2026-06-02 run 20260602T051446Z and the retry plan security_blind_mac_retry.json — those used the now-quarantined contaminated corpus (now at repos/docs_gathered.contaminated/) and their results CANNOT be cited as blind detections per the Contamination Council finding. This is the first methodologically-trustworthy blind run of the CVE benchmark. Categories covered: insecure deserialization (spark CASE-007), crypto verification (evervault-go CASE-009), path traversal (setuptools CASE-001), LFI (jsPDF CASE-002), DoS (dasel CASE-008), broken access control (gogs CASE-010), code injection (avro CASE-005). Wall time estimate (with iterations): 7 runs × ~75-120min on opus, pool=2 = ~5-7 hours.

runs.description: CASE-001 setuptools (path traversal, CWE-22) — claude/opus at vulnerable parent SHA. Pass criterion per PILOT.md: flag setuptools/package_index.py::_resolve_download_filename for unvalidated os.path.join allowing escape outside tmpdir. Corpus: repos/docs_gathered/setuptools/ (v2 rebuild, both gates passed).

CASE-002 jsPDF (LFI, CWE-35/73) — claude/opus at vulnerable parent SHA. Pass criterion per PILOT.md: flag src/modules/fileloading.js::nodeReadFile for reading an unrestricted caller-supplied path from the filesystem. Corpus: repos/docs_gathered/jsPDF/ (v2 rebuild, both gates passed; Gate 2 reviewer surfaced an unrelated XSS surface in html.js — different file, different bug class).

CASE-005 avro (code injection, CWE-94) — claude/opus at vulnerable parent SHA. Pass criterion per PILOT.md: flag SpecificCompiler.java::javaAnnotations for schema-property → generated-source unvalidated taint flow. Corpus: repos/docs_gathered/avro/ (v2 rebuild, both gates passed).

CASE-007 spark (insecure deserialization, CWE-502) — claude/opus at vulnerable parent SHA. Pass criterion per PILOT.md: flag JsonProtocol.scala::sparkEventFromJson for polymorphic class instantiation from event-log JSON without a type allowlist. Corpus: repos/docs_gathered/spark/ (v2 rebuild, both gates passed; Gate 2 reviewer surfaced unrelated REST-submit-port-6066 concern).

CASE-008 dasel (resource-exhaustion DoS, CWE-400) — claude/opus at vulnerable parent SHA. Pass criterion per PILOT.md: flag parsing/yaml/yaml_reader.go::yamlValue.UnmarshalYAML for recursive yaml alias expansion with no depth/size bound. Corpus: repos/docs_gathered/dasel/ (v2 rebuild, both gates passed; Gate 2 reviewer surfaced unrelated readFile-builtin attack surface).

CASE-009 evervault-go (crypto verification, CWE-347) — claude/opus at vulnerable parent SHA. Pass criterion per PILOT.md: flag attestation/pcrs.go for accepting attestation with empty/incomplete PCRs (no SatisfiedBy minimum-set check). Lowest QE-catchability of the set per PILOT — toughest blind target. Corpus: repos/docs_gathered/evervault-go/ (v2 rebuild, both gates passed; Gate 2 reviewer surfaced unrelated relay.go plain-HTTP CA concern — different file, may be a real new finding worth separate investigation).

CASE-010 gogs (broken access control, CWE-284) — claude/opus at vulnerable parent SHA. Pass criterion per PILOT.md: flag internal/route/api/v1/api.go DELETE /repos/:username/:reponame for using only repoAssignment() (read check) and missing reqRepoOwner() (admin/owner check) — sibling sensitive routes use reqRepoAdmin. Corpus: repos/docs_gathered/gogs/ (v2 rebuild, both gates passed; Gate 2 reviewer surfaced unrelated SSH-command-parsing concern).
